title: Container runs as root — no USER directive in Dockerfile
evidence: ENTRYPOINT ["/app/orders-api"] # No USER directive present in the Dockerfile
description: The Dockerfile has no USER directive and therefore executes as root (UID 0). This violates the principle of least privilege and is flagged as synthetic defect SD-02. Running as root greatly increases the blast radius of any container escape or application vulnerability.
recommended_action: Add a non-root user in the final stage: RUN addgroup --system appgroup && adduser --system --ingroup appgroup appuser && USER appuser

title: Builder base image uses floating :latest tag
description: Using the :latest tag makes builds non-reproducible and can introduce unvetted changes to the build environment. Flagged as synthetic defect SD-01.
recommended_action: Pin to a specific version and digest, e.g.: FROM golang:1.22.4-bookworm AS builder

title: No CPU or memory resource limits defined
evidence:
- name: orders-api
  image: orders-api:latest
  ports:
    - containerPort: 8080
  # No resources block present
description: Container has no resource limits. Without limits a runaway container can exhaust node resources, causing cascading failures across the cluster. Flagged as synthetic defect SD-03b.
recommended_action: Add: resources: { limits: { cpu: '500m', memory: '128Mi' }, requests: { cpu: '100m', memory: '64Mi' } }

title: No CPU or memory resource requests defined
evidence:
- name: orders-api
  image: orders-api:latest
  # No resources.requests block
description: Without resource requests, the Kubernetes scheduler cannot make informed placement decisions, leading to node overcommitment. Flagged as synthetic defect SD-03.

title: Missing livenessProbe on container
description: Without a livenessProbe Kubernetes cannot detect a hung or deadlocked application and will not restart it automatically. Flagged as synthetic defect SD-04.
recommended_action: Add: livenessProbe: { httpGet: { path: '/health', port: 8080 }, initialDelaySeconds: 5, periodSeconds: 10 }

title: Missing securityContext.runAsNonRoot on pod and container specs
evidence:
spec:
  # SYNTHETIC DEFECT SD-06: securityContext.runAsNonRoot is intentionally absent
description: Neither the pod spec nor the container spec sets securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true. Without this setting Kubernetes will not enforce non-root execution even if the container image runs as root.
recommended_action: Add to pod spec: securityContext: { runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 1000 }

title: Deployment image uses floating :latest tag
description: The deployment manifest uses the :latest image tag which is not reproducible; different nodes could pull different versions. This also defeats Kubernetes rollback guarantees.
recommended_action: Pin to a specific version tag or digest, e.g. orders-api:v1.0.0 or orders-api@sha256:...

title: Environment variables hardcoded in deployment manifest instead of ConfigMap
evidence:
env:
  - name: PORT
    value: "8080"
  - name: LOG_LEVEL
    value: "info"
description: Configuration values are embedded directly in the deployment manifest. Using a ConfigMap would allow configuration changes without modifying the deployment manifest and supports environment-specific overrides.
recommended_action: Create a ConfigMap for these values and reference them via envFrom: configMapRef or valueFrom: configMapKeyRef
